description: (0.5.0) Which registries' attestations a consumer accepts (RFC-ACDP-0021 §11). Behavioral, consumer-side.

input.golden: kl-001 (controller did:web:agents.example.com:ci, identity oidc https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com / repo:example/pipeline:ref:refs/heads/main, registry did:web:registry.example.com)

scenarios.name: A — no keyless attester configured and no trust list

expected.behavior: untrusted_attester. The default accepts no attester.

scenarios.name: B — attester in local keyless configuration
C — trust list applied and the keyless body evaluates trusted at the attesting registry
D — trust list applied and the body evaluates untrusted_registry, out_of_scope or expired
E — attestation body served from a registry other than its ctx_id authority

expected.behavior: attestation_invalid: agent_id MUST be did:web:<ctx_id authority>.
